analysis.bootstrap: 10000 paired row resamples, PCG64 seed 2026102401. Each of two primary estimands gets two-sided 97.5% percentile interval (Bonferroni family target 95%; descriptive, not an exact finite-sample guarantee). Claim budget-related benefit only if both lower bounds > 0. Otherwise report inconclusive/no demonstrated benefit, not equivalence.
analysis.fixed_before_test: No validation tuning, temperature scaling or conformal selection in this experiment. Fit and save all four heads before scoring any test head. All four curves reported, no winning-budget selection.
analysis.optimization: Same fixed 200 Adam steps at each budget; this measures fixed-training-procedure budget benefit, not an optimal linear classifier. Report gradient norm; never repair optimizer after seeing test.
analysis.secondary: Accuracy for both heads at all four budgets, training CE/objective and final gradient L2, wall time, RSS. No additional significance claims.

dataset.license_note: Original README permits academic research and non-commercial use. Raw text stays local. No commercial or redistribution permission inferred.

encoder.pooling: native last nonpadding token then L2 normalization
encoder.profile: unprompted document mode; not claim optimal classification prompting

heads.centroid: normalize each class mean of normalized features; score cosine

logistic.objective: mean cross entropy + 0.001/2 * sum(W**2), bias unpenalized
logistic.selection: primary adaptation comparator against centroid; no test-driven tuning

license: AG News research/non-commercial terms only; raw text stays local, no commercial or redistribution rights inferred; Harrier model card MIT.
limits: New disjoint historical same-source sample, NOT unseen source-family or future data.
Title/full-text unions do not remove semantic story overlap or training contamination.
Removal of duplicate components changes sampled population and may bias difficulty.
One nested training draw, test-row intervals conditional on this draw; cannot infer training-set sampling variability.
200-step fixed optimization may confound data budget with optimization quality.
The old negative head and LAC findings remain intact.
This is only head-budget diagnosis, not five-model replacement or deployment qualification.

power_planning.no_optional_stopping: Fixed n=1600; do not expand test or tune sample budget on observed scores.
power_planning.test_accuracy_difference_se: sqrt((discordance-delta**2)/1600); discordance scenarios 0.05,0.10,0.20. Rough 80% power delta=(z_0.9875+z_0.8)*sqrt(discordance/1600). Gain estimand has additional covariance and no assured power.

primary_estimands: paired gain in logistic-minus-centroid accuracy from n=320 to n=2560
question: Does a fixed logistic head benefit relative to centroid when only its training sample budget increases?

resource_budget.download_status: Not initiated. Existing runtime/cache absent; restoration to be coordinated by parent. No paid compute or giant model.

selection.groups: Union records sharing NFKC whitespace-collapsed casefolded title OR full text. Component key is minimum full-text hash. Remove whole components spanning official train/test, containing conflicting labels, or intersecting any of the old 960 selected full-text groups. Select lowest source row index in each remaining component.
selection.labels: Not stratified. No test class counts or scores consulted for selection. Missing training class aborts without reseeding.
selection.ranking: sha256(salt|official_split|component_key); prefix nesting for training; first 1600 eligible test components
